2609.03949.title: VestigeKV: The NoPE-MLA KV Cache Carries Its Own Eviction Signal in a Vestigial Branch
2609.03949.paper_summary: The problem. A long-lived KV cache must be compressed before the queries that will read it exist; selection by observed attention (H2O, SnapKV) collapses there (0.00-0.33 needle retrieval on a NoPE MLA model), because a token's importance has not yet been observed. The method. On Kimi Linear, VestigeKV evicts by a query-independent signal the cache already carries: the 64-dimensional decoupled branch, a vestige of RoPE that NoPE training repurposes into a salience channel. Reading 11% of each row, it partitions the cache: the top-m rows stay in the attended tier; every other row moves -- exactly, never deleted -- to a GPU-resident archive reachable per step by a certified trigger. No training, no quantization, no weight or kernel change. Cost. Nothing measurable: retrieval holds at 1.00 under 8x and 0.92 under 32x from 8k to 65k context, zero gap to full-row selection. The attended tier is 0.25 KB of Kimi Linear's 8.1 KB per-token cache at 32x; the archive stays bit-exact and GPU-resident, with host offload as the VRAM-reclaiming variant. The recall tier -- the standard configuration -- holds 128x at 1.00. Kimi K3 is reported to use a NoPE Gated-MLA variant; if its cache layout matches, the method plausibly extends there -- we make no claim beyond the measured model. NoPE exclusivity. The identical operator on a RoPE MLA collapses to 0.08 (plain eviction: 0.42); query-independent salience itself exists only without rotation (top-1 targets span 2.3-6.7% of tokens vs. 10.2-46.8%), and query-universal exact merging is provably impossible under RoPE. All thresholds were frozen before data; 20 archived verdicts and 8 closed routes accompany the paper.
2609.03949.paper_summary_zh: 問題。長期存在的 KV 快取必須在查詢存在之前進行壓縮；通過觀察到的注意力進行選擇（H2O，SnapKV）在那裡崩潰（在 NoPE MLA 模型上，針對 0.00-0.33 的針對性檢索），因為一個標記的重要性尚未被觀察到。方法。在 Kimi Linear 上，VestigeKV 透過查詢無關的信號驅逐快取，該信號已經存在於快取中：64 維的解耦分支，RoPE 的一個殘餘，NoPE 訓練將其重新用於顯著性通道。閱讀每一行的 11%，它將快取分區：前 m 行保留在被注意的層級；每其他行移動——精確地，從不刪除——到一個每步可通過經過認證的觸發器到達的 GPU 常駐檔案。無需訓練，無需量化，無需權重或內核變更。成本。沒有可測量的東西：在 8 倍下檢索保持在 1.00，並在 32 倍下保持在 0.92，從 8k 到 65k 的上下文，與完整行選擇之間沒有差距。被注意的層級在 32 倍時是 Kimi Linear 每標記快取的 0.25 KB 的 8.1 KB；檔案保持位元精確且 GPU 常駐，主機卸載作為 VRAM 回收變體。回憶層級——標準配置——在 1.00 下保持 128 倍。據報導，Kimi K3 使用 NoPE Gated-MLA 變體；如果其快取佈局匹配，該方法合理地在那裡擴展——我們不對測量模型之外的內容提出任何主張。NoPE 獨佔性。在 RoPE MLA 上，相同的運算子崩潰至 0.08（普通驅逐：0.42）；查詢無關的顯著性本身僅在沒有旋轉的情況下存在（前 1 的目標跨越 2.3-6.7% 的標記對比 10.2-46.8%），而查詢通用的精確合併在 RoPE 下被證明是不可能的。所有閾值在數據之前已經凍結；20 個存檔裁決和 8 條關閉路徑隨著論文一起附上。
